description: This file defines the requirement_mgr class, responsible for managing requirements within the TestLink project. It includes methods for creating, updating, deleting, retrieving, and exporting requirements, as well as handling custom fields, attachments, and relationships. The class interacts extensively with the database and other modules to implement requirements management functionalities.

classes.name: requirement_mgr
classes.description: This class manages requirements, including CRUD operations, exporting to XML, importing from XML, handling custom fields and attachments, and managing relationships between requirements and other entities within the TestLink framework.

classes.name: requirement_mgr
classes.description: This class manages requirements, including CRUD operations, exporting/importing, handling custom fields, attachments, and notations of requirements relationships within the TestLink framework.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new requirement with specified details like srs_id, reqdoc_id, title, scope, user_id, status, type, expected_coverage, node_order, tproject_id, and options.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing requirement version with new details like reqdoc_id, title, scope, user_id, status, type, expected_coverage, node_order, and tproject_id.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a requirement or its specific version(s), along with related attachments, relations, and custom fields.

methods.name: get_by_id
methods.description: Retrieves requirement information by ID, with options for version, filters, and output formats.

methods.name: exportReqToXML
methods.description: Exports a requirement to XML format, including optional attachments and custom fields.

methods.name: createFromXML
methods.description: Creates a requirement in the system based on XML data, associating it with a test project and parent node.

methods.name: createFromMap
methods.description: Creates a requirement from a data map, handling custom fields, attachments, and validity checks.

methods.name: xmlToMapRequirement
methods.description: Parses an XML item into a requirement data map.

methods.name: create_tc_from_requirement
methods.description: Generates test cases based on requirements.

methods.name: assign_to_tcase
methods.description: Associates requirements with a test case, linking the latest active versions.

methods.name: get_relationships
methods.description: Retrieves test cases related to a requirement.

methods.name: get_all_for_tcase
methods.description: Fetches all requirements assigned to a specific test case.

methods.name: set_order
methods.description: Sets or changes the order of requirements in bulk.

methods.name: html_table_of_custom_field_inputs
methods.description: Returns HTML table with custom field input elements for a requirement.

methods.name: html_table_of_custom_field_values
methods.description: Returns HTML table displaying custom field labels and values for a requirement.

methods.name: values_to_db
methods.description: Saves custom field values to the database.

methods.name: customFieldValuesAsXML
methods.description: Generates XML representation of custom field values for a requirement.

methods.name: check_basic_data
methods.description: Performs validation checks on requirement title and document ID.

methods.name: get_linked_cfields
methods.description: Retrieves linked custom fields for a requirement or requirement version.

methods.name: values_to_db
methods.description: Designs and saves custom field values array to the database for a specific requirement node and custom field map.

methods.name: customFieldValuesAsXML
methods.description: Exports linked custom field values of a requirement as an XML string.

methods.name: getByDocID
methods.description: Retrieves requirement information based on document ID, optionally filtered by test project and parent requirement specification.

methods.name: copy_to
methods.description: Copies a requirement, possibly into another requirement specification, with optional copying of related test case assignments and attachments.

methods.name: copy_attachments
methods.description: Copies attachments from one requirement version to another.

methods.name: copy_cfields
methods.description: Copies linked custom fields from a source requirement version to a target one, optionally within a specific test project.

methods.name: generateDocID
methods.description: Generates a unique document ID for a requirement within the specified test project, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: create_req_only
methods.description: Creates a requirement node with minimal information, returning success status and the new requirement ID.

methods.name: create_version
methods.description: Creates a new version for a requirement with specified scope, status, type, expected coverage, and author.

methods.name: create_new_version
methods.description: Creates a new version for a requirement, optionally frozen from last version, with version number incremented.

methods.name: get_last_version_info
methods.description: Retrieves info about the latest version of a requirement.

methods.name: get_last_doc_id_for_testproject
methods.description: Fetches the last involved requirement document ID for a specific test project.

methods.name: copy_version
methods.description: Duplicates a requirement version, copying custom fields, attachments, and managing version relations.

methods.name: closeOpenTCVersionOnOpenLinks
methods.description: Sets linked test case versions to closed if they are open and linked to a specific requirement version.

methods.name: updateOpen
methods.description: Updates the 'is_open' status of a requirement version.

methods.name: updateActive
methods.description: Updates the 'active' status of a requirement version.

methods.name: get_relations
methods.description: Retrieves all relations involving a specific requirement, with detailed labels and related test project info.

methods.name: check_if_relation_exists
methods.description: Checks whether a relation of a specific type exists between two requirements.

methods.name: count_relations
methods.description: Counts all relations connected to a given requirement.

methods.name: add_relation
methods.description: Adds a new relation between two requirements with a specified type and author.

methods.name: delete_relation
methods.description: Removes a specific relation by relation ID.

methods.name: delete_all_relations
methods.description: Removes all relations for one or multiple requirements.

methods.name: get_all_relation_labels
methods.description: Initializes labels for all relation types available in configuration.

methods.name: init_relation_type_select
methods.description: Prepares data for dropdown selection of relation types, including localization.

methods.name: getByAttribute
methods.description: Searches for requirements by key attributes like title or document ID, with output options.

methods.name: get_last_child_info
methods.description: Gets latest child info (versions or revisions) of a requirement node, with specified output detail.

methods.name: create_new_revision
methods.description: Creates a new revision for a requirement, with optional revision info and logs.

methods.name: copy_version_as_revision
methods.description: Copies existing requirement version data and associated custom fields to a new revision.

methods.name: get_history
methods.description: Generates change history of a requirement across revisions and versions, with optional detailed output.

methods.name: decode_users
methods.description: Decodes user IDs to display names for the provided result set.

methods.name: generateUniqueTitle
methods.description: Generates a unique requirement title within the same test project, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: getTestProjectID
methods.description: Retrieves the test project ID associated with a requirement or specification.

methods.name: getAllByContext
methods.description: Fetches all requirement IDs based on the context such as test project and optional test plan and platform.

methods.name: getFileUploadRelativeURL
methods.description: Provides URL for uploading files related to a requirement version.

methods.name: getDeleteAttachmentRelativeURL
methods.description: Provides URL for deleting a file attachment from a requirement version.

methods.name: exportRelationToXML
methods.description: Exports a requirement relation as an XML string, including source/destination info and project, type.

methods.name: convertRelationXmlToRelationMap
methods.description: Converts an XML representation of a relation into a map of relation data.

methods.name: createRelationFromXML
methods.description: Creates a requirement relation from an XML node, with project and author info.

methods.name: createRelationFromMap
methods.description: Creates a requirement relation based on a provided relation map, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: get_version
methods.description: Retrieves detailed info about a specific requirement version.

methods.name: get_revision
methods.description: Retrieves detailed info about a specific requirement revision.

methods.name: get_version_revision
methods.description: Retrieves a requirement's version details based on version ID and optional revision info.

methods.name: getByDocIDInProject
methods.description: Retrieves requirement(s) by document ID within a specific project or test project ID, allowing optional filtering via parent ID and options.

methods.name: getByIDBulkLatestVersionRevision
methods.description: Fetches the latest version and revision info for one or multiple requirement IDs, including user display names, with internal caching to optimize user info retrieval.

methods.name: getCoverageCounter
methods.description: Returns the count of coverage entries for a specific requirement ID.

methods.name: getCoverageCounterSet
methods.description: Returns coverage counts for a set of requirement IDs, grouped by each requirement.

methods.name: getRelationsCounters
methods.description: Calculates the total number of relations connected to each requirement in a given set.

methods.name: updateScope
methods.description: Updates the scope field for a specific requirement version.

methods.name: renderImageAttachments
methods.description: Embeds image attachments directly into text fields marked with specific tags, replacing placeholders with inline images.

methods.name: inlineImageProcessing
methods.description: Processes inline images within the scope of a requirement, updating scope content with embedded images.

methods.name: monitorOn
methods.description: Registers a user as monitoring a specific requirement, inserting into the monitoring table if not already present.

methods.name: monitorOff
methods.description: Removes monitoring registration for a user (or all users) on a specific requirement.

methods.name: getMonitoredByUser
methods.description: Retrieves the list of requirements monitored by a specific user, optionally filtering by requirement specification ID.

methods.name: getReqMonitors
methods.description: Fetches the users monitoring a specific requirement, returning either a detailed array or map by user ID.

methods.name: notifyMonitors
methods.description: Sends email notifications to all users monitoring a requirement about actions performed, using localized email templates.

methods.name: getMonitorMailCfg
methods.description: Provides email template configurations based on different actions (e.g., new version, delete).

methods.name: setNotifyOn
methods.description: Configures notification settings.

methods.name: getNotifyOn
methods.description: Retrieves current notification settings.

methods.name: updateCoverage
methods.description: Creates or updates coverage links for requirements and test cases, optionally freezing previous coverage.

methods.name: updateTCVLinkStatus
methods.description: Updates the link status of a requirement version to test case version relations.

methods.name: getAllReqVersionIDForReq
methods.description: Fetches all requirement version IDs associated with a set of requirement IDs.

methods.name: getActiveForTCVersion
methods.description: Retrieves active requirements associated with specified test case versions.

methods.name: getGoodForTCVersion
methods.description: Fetches requirements related to given test case versions, optionally with verbose info.

methods.name: getActiveForReqVersion
methods.description: Retrieves active requirements related to a specific requirement version.

methods.name: delReqVersionTCVersionLink
methods.description: Removes the relation between a requirement version and a test case version, logging audit event.

methods.name: delReqVersionTCVersionLinkByID
methods.description: Deletes a specific relation by its ID, also performing audit logging.

methods.name: getLatestReqVersionCoverageCounterSet
methods.description: Returns coverage counts for requirements based on latest requirement versions, active only.

methods.name: bulkAssignLatestREQVTCV
methods.description: Assigns the latest requirement versions to multiple test case versions, avoiding duplicate links, and returns count of new links created.

methods.name: assignReqVerToTCVer
methods.description: Creates an individual link between a requirement version and a test case version, with audit trail.

methods.name: getGoodForReqVersion
methods.description: Retrieves detailed info about requirements associated with a specific requirement version, with options for verbosity and test project filtering.
